test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ie_join_ranges (lo Int32, hi Int32) ENGINE = Memory
test.query: SELECT count() FROM (SELECT toInt32(number % 16) AS x FROM numbers(1000000)) AS p JOIN ie_join_ranges AS r ON p.x >= r.lo AND p.x <= r.hi FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM (SELECT toInt32(number % 16) AS x FROM numbers(1000000)) AS p JOIN (SELECT lo, lo + 3 AS hi FROM ie_join_ranges) AS r ON p.x >= r.lo AND p.x <= r.hi FORMAT Null
